prose: Author and ancient civilization investigator Camille Sauvé joins InnerVerse to discuss her book, Sorcerers of Stone: Architects of the Three Ages. While investigating the hundreds of other-worldly structures around Peru, Camille discovered unsolved mysteries that connect unexplained megalithic sites worldwide. Tune in for topics including leylines, altered states, portals, cataclysms, expanding Earth theories, geopolymer technologies, and a show & tell of epic "Cyclopean" masonry in Peru.
ext: We look at sites worldwide that resemble the Peruvian architecture, consider evidence for giant petrified animals, ask whether ancient sites were engineered for acoustic resonance and sound healing, learn of psychic activations and metaphysical initiations, free energy and antiquitech potentials, applied Biogeometry, dowsing, and mysterious hybrid human mummies of Nazca.
